PM Modi Chairs Meetings on West Asia Crisis and Domestic Issues

Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired at least two high-level meetings. One meeting focused on the West Asia crisis, reviewing its impact on India's energy security, fertilizer supplies, and the safety of Indians abroad. Discussions also covered maintaining uninterrupted supply chains amidst global conflicts. Another meeting involved government secretaries to review the agenda for 'Viksit Bharat'. Additionally, the Prime Minister held a phone call with the new UK Prime Minister, Rishi Sunak, discussing AI, trade, and the West Asia situation.
